verdict.rationale: Sentry documents custom Dashboards made of widgets that each visualize one or more datasets across multiple projects. The free tier includes 10 custom dashboards, and a Grafana integration exists for visualizing Sentry data externally. However, the evidence never shows sharing, a range of visualization types, or template variables. Missing for 10: evidence of dashboard sharing/permissions, documented rich visualization types, template variables, independent hands-on corroboration.
